results.check:
G1 [THE OPERATOR] nabla^2 phi - xi^2 nabla^4 phi = 4 pi G M delta^3 has
      phi = -G M (1 - e^{-r/xi})/r: verified in Fourier space over six
      decades of k

G2 [NO 1/r] inside xi the force ratio is r^2/(2 xi^2) -- a constant, a
      uniform force and an r^2 term, with NO 1/r

S1 [THE SCREENING] at 1 AU the scalar is suppressed by 1e-9 relative to
      an unscreened scalar; at Saturn 1e-7; at Neptune 1e-6

F1 [DARK ENERGY SURVIVES] the biharmonic term is built from SPATIAL
      derivatives; for a homogeneous phi it vanishes identically, so
      X = 0 and D^2 phi = 0: f(0) = -1 and w = -1 are UNCHANGED

F2 [MOND SURVIVES] at galactic radii the biharmonic term is suppressed
      by (xi/r)^2 relative to the gradient term

F3 [COLD SECTOR SURVIVES] (D^2 phi)^2 is invariant under
      phi -> phi + const, so the Noether charge and a^-3 are unchanged
results.measured: shift symmetry preserved: D^2(phi + c) = D^2 phi

C1 [THE EPIIEMERIS CONSTRAINT] the uniform effective density inside
      Saturn's orbit clears the Pitjev & Pitjeva bound

C2 [THE GALACTIC CONSTRAINT] in the Newtonian regime mu_2 -> 1, so the
      MOND scalar carries no extra force there: G_eff -> G and f -> 0
      automatically -- constraint (2) is satisfied by the FUNCTION
